source_pipeline: configs/countries/us.yaml → sync_socrata.py + sync_census_popest.py → raw.us_sf_* → dbt_us_staging → dbt_us_analytics → dbt_us_marts → export_us_sf.py

dimension_notes.department: The paying department, on the City's own code. Grouped on the code and not the name: the FY2018 system migration re-cased every label, so grouping on the label splits one department in two.
dimension_notes.org_group: The Controller's seven service areas — the same top-level grouping the budget page uses, so the two pages cut the money the same way.
dimension_notes.kind: The display bucket of the PAYEE (supplier, nonprofit, healthcare, fiscal agent, payroll pass-through, individual). Vendors the classification seed does not cover are shown as 'unclassified' rather than dropped — the gap is a fact about the classification, not a rounding error.

denominator_note: Every dimension sums to the same figure: that fiscal year's total payments. Switching lens re-cuts one total; it never changes what is being measured.
